note: Edge cases of the v4 fold that the ledgerd TypeScript fold (schema 3, removed) could not express: held copies, the Undo pairs the app writes (a budget move, a budget edit, a same-purchase confirmation, a reopened copy), archived and held rows around same-purchase pairing, and money at the Int64 limits where the v4 fold records money_overflow or refuses the amount instead of carrying an unbounded number. Written by the Swift executor; a case listed in HasalaCoreConformanceTests EdgeGoldens.pairs also pins SamePurchase.pairs over its folded state.
format: Each case is a conformance/replay case (log items of ops, expect.state blanked as there, expect.state_sha256 the pass condition), folded by the v4 fold.

cases.name: held-copy-at-the-int64-ceiling
cases.note: The same alert at 2^63-1 from two mailboxes four minutes apart: the second is held as a copy of the first; both convert at the identity to 2^63-1 exactly.

cases.name: held-copy-kept-then-reopened
cases.note: Keep both counts the copy; the undo (decision null) holds it again against the same row.

cases.name: move-and-its-undo
cases.note: A move and its undo net to zero in both cells and mark the move undone. A second undo of the same move, an undo with another amount, an undo in another month and an undo of an undo are plan_undo_mismatch and move nothing. An assign from Ready to assign undoes back to it.

cases.name: move-at-the-plan-cap
cases.note: A plan amount is at most 9999999999999 fils (13 digits), far below 2^63-1. Assigning the cap fits and its undo nets the cell to zero; one fils past the cap is an invalid_payload that moves nothing, and so is an undo naming it.

cases.name: budget-edit-and-its-undo
cases.note: October inherits 1000.00 onward from September and has 200.00 moved in (1200.00). An edit sets 1500.00 onward; its undo writes what the app writes: 1000.00 onward, then 1200.00 for October only. November inherits 1000.00 again.

cases.name: same-purchase-and-its-undo
cases.note: Confirming the pair gives the USD row the AED amount as its stated value and archives the AED posting with a note; the undo the app writes with the live rate thaws the stated value, sets the rate again so the row re-freezes at it, and clears the archive and the note. The pair is offered again.

cases.name: pairing-skips-archived-and-held-rows
cases.note: A USD purchase, its AED posting from mailbox A and the same posting from mailbox B four minutes later, held as a copy. The posting is archived: neither the archived posting nor the held copy is offered as the pair.

cases.name: pairing-takes-the-kept-copy
cases.note: Keep both on the held copy makes it a counted posting of its own, and it is offered as the pair.

cases.name: pairing-after-unarchive
cases.note: Unarchiving the posting offers it as the pair again; the held copy is still held.

cases.name: conversion-overflow-is-recorded
cases.note: A USD row at 2^63-1 at 2.000000 does not fit Int64 in AED: the fold records money_overflow and the row waits with no home amount; a later rate of 1.000000 backfills it to 2^63-1.

cases.name: amount-past-int64-is-refused
cases.note: An amount of 2^63 is not money: the row is an invalid_payload and is not created, while 2^63-1 in the next op is.
